itinerary.title: Gardens, old lanes & lake light
itinerary.description: Explore a selection of Srinagar gardens and the lakefront. A shared shikara session and specified garden entry are part of the proposed plan. Choose a focused old-city option around Khanqah-e-Moula, the Zaina Kadal / Maharaj Gunj lanes and Jamia Masjid / Nowhatta, with current religious access checked. A separate Bait-ul-Meeras and appointed carpet or traditional-art visit can replace this programme or be added with an extra night; it is not assumed alongside every garden stop.

extensions.title: One more Pahalgam valley day
extensions.description: Request two nights for a slower Pahalgam stay, choosing Aru or Betaab on separate outings rather than rushing both. This may change the main route; local transport, entry charges, hotel and extra cost are quoted separately.

extensions.title: Southern springs with an overnight
extensions.description: Discuss a separate Kokernag or Daksum-area night so the southern valley has its own time. The overnight base, road access, heating and return route need confirmation rather than being added to a busy transfer day.

extensions.title: Srinagar heritage, museum and craft time
extensions.description: Add a separate city day for Bait-ul-Meeras and one appointed carpet, weaving or traditional-art visit, or a focused shrine-and-market walk. Opening, worship, host participation and all fees must be confirmed.
